about_the_game:
What is "love"? — Discover lost memories and the meaning of love in a desolate world

“In a World Without People” is a side-scrolling pixel art adventure game set in a ruined, post-human world.

A mysterious plague swept across the globe, and humanity vanished.
The world fell silent.
── Nearly a thousand years later, a lone robot awakens.

As it wanders the decaying world, fragments of memories with humans slowly begin to return.
The robot continues to search—until the moment it understands the emotion known as "love."

About the Demo

In the demo, you can play through the first 10 to 15 minutes of the game.
It offers a brief introduction to the story and lets you experience the atmosphere of the game.
Save data will not carry over to the full version. Thank you for your understanding.

In the full version, the opening section will be further polished and improved!
We're also planning to further improve the translations for an even better experience!

Explore: Walk through a desolate world

Take control of the robot and explore a quiet, ruined world at your own pace.
Investigate mysterious places, use items you find along the way, and solve small puzzles to gradually uncover the story behind the silence.

Memory: A journey into the past

The robot has lost all memory of who it was and what it once did.
By discovering old computers of the same model as its own head and transplanting their memory units, it begins to recover fragments of the past.
What emerges is the story of humanity's final days.
As the robot learns what "love" meant to this world, a new light begins to shine on its own fate.

Art: A pixel world shaped by depth and light

Enjoy a richly detailed pixel art world where lighting and depth bring every scene to life.
Carefully crafted visuals evoke both the stillness of a ruined world and a nostalgic sense of warmth.

Streaming and Video Content

We generally welcome gameplay streaming and video uploads.
Please check the official guidelines via the “Visit the website” button on the right.
We also offer downloadable assets such as thumbnails on the same page.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains themes related to death.
It does not include graphic or overly grotesque depictions.

short_description: A post-apocalyptic pixel art narrative adventure where a robot, awakened in a ruined world after humanity's extinction, traces its memories with humans and discovers “love.” In a quiet, beautiful, and lonely world, this is the story of a robot—until it chooses to shut itself down.
